name: keyless-executors
description: Permissionless Keyless executors — FXRP direct minting, Conditional-policy releases, and scheduled payments. Each completes a step the user's own policy already authorised.

scripts.// start: Railway runs this. Every watcher lives here, so WATCHER picks which one a service runs: 'mint' (default), 'conditional', or 'scheduled'. Deploy the same repo root once per watcher.
